naya.title: Superbrain 10/10 Execution Cycle — Naya Note
naya.summary: The Superbrain now has an executable continuity contract enforced by its authoritative gate. Meaningful executions must preserve paired representations, verification, durable receipts, delivery state, AI-to-AI handoff, learning, and a next action.
lessons: The Superbrain must enforce its laws in code and CI, not merely document them.
A deliberate failing test proved the new guard could expose a real continuity defect.
An in-progress execution must be explicitly marked IN_PROGRESS; completed work must prove VERIFIED.
Green must be observed from the actual Actions job and logs.
next_best_actions: Harden automated entity resolution and contradiction/supersession.
Upgrade retrieval to semantic/vector and benchmark precision/recall.
Automate CIS compounding and cold-start restoration acceptance.

human.title: Superbrain 10/10 Execution Cycle — Shawn Note
human.summary: We did not just document the continuity law. We made the Superbrain gate enforce it, intentionally broke the contract to prove the guard caught it, repaired the real event, and then observed the full brain-gate pass with every substantive step green.
lessons: The user should be able to see what happened, why it happened, and the evidence.
The system should preserve useful learning so the next AI starts stronger.
next_best_actions: Continue the remaining 10/10 intelligence gaps in dependency order without disturbing the green foundation.
